output.explanation_si: This is not the same electrical panel as in the owner's photo. B shows a different set of components and labels.
output.explanation_en: Photo B does not show the same physical electrical panel as Photo A.
mismatches: A top section shows white contactors with black braided jumper wires and blue/yellow/red/black wiring - not present in B
A bottom breakers have a long blue busbar/handle strip across white breakers - B has a red main switch and black toggles with no blue strip
B has ABB branding and yellow labels F1.0, F2.0, F3.0, F4.0, F5.0, F6.0 on the breakers - not present in A
B has orange modules on the left and a 'K9.1 Frostschutz' label on the right - not present in A
Enclosure and cable trunking colour and layout differ: A shows angled white divider with exposed multi-colour wiring, B shows straight beige trunking with different wire terminations
